cases.name: Susan Camille Heffner Thomas
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "She was a retired teacher who formerly taught at Burlington Christian Academy, Abundant Life Christian Academy and Clover Garden. She was a graduate of Hugh M Cummings High School and Oral Roberts University. The foundation of her life was faith, family and her many friends.  She was known for her sense of humor, artistic gifts of painting, crafts, knitting and kindness. Camille also taught classes on different kinds of needlework at ACC and at the Kernodle Senior Center.  She volunteered at the White House in Graham. She had a great love for animals and always had a dog or cat. She enjoyed horseback riding, bee keeping  . Camille was an active member of  Burlington Assembly of God  where she sang in the choir, volunteered for several groups.  She was an active member of the Alamance Chorale."
